collections.description: Per registry name: the level its records have in git (default: public or members; `level` is read as a synonym) and single fields made stricter (fields: public, members, hat:<hat ref> or role:<role id>; a hat or role field's values live in the private store, L5 spec §9.2). A collection not listed is members.

defaults.description: L5's defaults for data kept outside git. They change no git record. contact: the hat or role that keeps contact details (L5 spec §9.2).
